label: Body & Health
source: owner corpus content/rules.json (frozen); decisions index-joined to corpus rule order

added.text: Increase the demand on your body every week. Adaptation only comes from overload.
Maintain your range of motion deliberately. Stiffness is decay, not destiny.
Train toward a measurable target. A distance, a weight, a time. Vague effort produces vague results.
See a doctor for preventive care, not just when something breaks. Early detection expands your options.
Give your body recovery time after illness, grief, or prolonged stress. Pushing through depletes what rest alone restores.
